control.name: tbcSelectStep
control.description: Specifies the current process step. All steps that precede it are also painted as active (selected).

control.name: icbOrientation
control.description: Allows you to choose between vertical and horizontal control orientation.

control.name: ceInversedProgressDirection
control.description: Specifies whether the control is flipped horizontally (or vertically, if its StepProgressBar.Orientation is Vertical).

control.name: ceDrawConnectors
control.description: Specifies whether the control should draw connectors between neighboring items.

control.name: ceFillIndicators
control.description: Allows you to fill central indicator area when the item is in the Inactive state.

control.name: ceShowStepIcons
control.description: Allows you to show or hide images in the items content block.

control.name: ceShowIndicatorIcons
control.description: Allows you to show or hide images in the items indicators.

control.name: ceDrawShadows
control.description: Specifies whether to add a glow effect to the indicators and connectors.

control.name: ceAllowUserInteraction
control.description: Specifies whether users can select steps using the mouse or keyboard.
